description: Lists every European electricity market (bidding zone) SpotWave covers, with its code, display name and billing currency. Use the code (e.g. "NL", "DE", "SE3", "NO1", "DK1", "ITN") as the `market` argument of the other tools. Countries split into several zones (Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Italy) have one code per zone.
name: list_markets
title: List electricity markets
